card.name: Small words before country or government
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, it, what, because, how) in policy or politics text, right before a likely mention of a country, state or government.

modes.label: Before country names
modes.description: The word comes before a ranking or description of a nation.
modes.example: making it<< the>> world’s 15th wealthiest country

modes.label: Before government or state terms
modes.description: A linking word comes just before state law or government spending.
modes.example: Options are limited in Missouri<< because>> state law restricts the creation of charter

modes.label: Before policy actions
modes.description: A verb or linking word in a policy sentence, where a government actor is expected next.
modes.example: a school choice policy that<< allows>> students to take public dollars with them to

card.writes: It pushes toward words like state, government and countries, and away from hospital and school words.
card.plain: It fires on small words in politics and policy text when a country or government term is likely to come next.
